name: Huntress Shot, Moon Arrow and Starfire Shot cast in the client's 2.5/2.5/3.0 s, scaled by ranged haste (#1324)
contract: The report (level 26 Starcaller) says Huntress Shot, Moon Arrow and Starfire Shot used to cast in 1.25 s and
now take 1.85 s. Shipped client data: Huntress Shot 680220 and Moon Arrow 801972 have CastingTimeIndex 5
(SpellCastTimes 2000 ms, PerLevel 0, Minimum 2000); Starfire Shot 801978 has index 19 (2500 ms). All three carry
category 133, so 1250 ms is their global cooldown, not a cast time. The CoA client's own cast-time routine
(Ascension.exe, Spell_C.cpp function at VA 0x7ff180, called by the spell tooltip before SPELL_CAST_TIME_SEC at
0x624471) takes the SpellCastTimes base, applies SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, applies UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED only to
spells without IS_ABILITY/TRADESPELL, then 'test byte [spell+0x10], 2' adds 500 ms for ranged-slot spells and
scales by UNIT_FIELD_RANGEDATTACKTIME over the ranged weapon's delay (ranged haste). The client therefore shows
2.5, 2.5 and 3.0 s unhasted. The server matches: SpellInfo::CalcCastTime adds the same 500 ms and
Unit::ModSpellCastTime multiplies ranged-class casts by m_modAttackSpeedPct[RANGED_ATTACK]. Expected on an
unhasted level-26 fixture: 2500, 2500 and 3000 ms. Starbarian rank 1 704778 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE
4) divides them by 1.04: 2403.8 and 2884.6 ms. A real Huntress Shot on a hostile golem 15 yd ahead (Worn
Shortbow 2504 in the ranged slot, as in starcaller-moon-priest-huntress-shot-stars) starts with 2200..2500 ms
on its cast timer and a 1050..1250 ms global cooldown, has 150..530 ms left after a 2000 ms wait, completes
within 1 s and damages the target. Nothing in the shipped data gives a 1.25 s cast; the report's 1.85 s
depends on the reporter's ranged haste and talents, which the report does not include.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Huntress Shot: 2000 ms base plus the 500 ms ranged-slot time the client also adds
Moon Arrow: 2000 ms base plus 500 ms
Starfire Shot: 2500 ms base plus 500 ms
Starbarian rank 1 is active on the hasted fixture
4% ranged haste shortens Huntress Shot to 2500/1.04
4% ranged haste shortens Starfire Shot to 3000/1.04
Fire Huntress Shot at the golem
The real cast starts with its 2500 ms timer
The 1.25 s in the report is the shot's global cooldown
About 500 ms of the cast remain
The completed shot damages the golem
